flagged.issue: The cited page states the 90-day holding and driver-education waiver but does not state the 40 hours with 10 after sunset.

flagged.issue: The cited page provides only the tail of the under-18 supervision rule, with the instructor and parent/guardian options stated on the prior page.
flagged.suggested_fix: On this page, an adult age 21 or older may supervise if the parent/legal guardian is not licensed, with permission proof, and the adult is licensed.

flagged.issue: The page also allows accompaniment by a licensed driver 21 in front and passenger exceptions do not include work or school travel.
flagged.suggested_fix: Age 16 with a license: 12 am-5 am and immediate-family-only passengers for six months; exceptions include licensed driver 21, agriculture, work/school for nighttime, and emergency.

flagged.issue: The page says observation may be required by school, not that it is always required.
flagged.suggested_fix: Behind-the-wheel training needs 6 hours driving and 6 hours observation by a licensed instructor, which may be required by school.

flagged.issue: The cited page does not state the 40 hours with 10 after sunset for ages 15 to 18.
flagged.suggested_fix: This page requires completed driver education and 6-month holding at 16-17 and driver education at 18, without stating 40 hours.

flagged.issue: The cited page states the 90-day and waiver rule but does not state the 40 hours with 10 after sunset.
flagged.suggested_fix: Drivers 19+ must hold a learner permit 90 days unless completing approved driver education, per this page.

flagged.issue: The cited page states the licensed-driver front-seat requirement but does not state immediate possession on this page.
flagged.suggested_fix: The front-seat supervisor must be a licensed driver 21 or as table-listed; immediate possession is not stated on this page.

flagged.issue: The cited page lists fees and contains no holding-period rule.
flagged.suggested_fix: Remove the claim from this page; holding periods are stated on the learner-permit holding-periods page, not the fees page.

flagged.issue: The cited page does not state any social-security document list.
flagged.suggested_fix: Omit the social-security list unless sourced to the page that states it.

flagged.issue: The page lists those items but does not state the two-document, 90-day, and bank-statement requirements in the provided text.
flagged.suggested_fix: State only the residency items actually listed on the page and omit the two-document and 90-day rule unless sourced elsewhere.

flagged.issue: The page exempts only a learner permit, not an ID card.
flagged.suggested_fix: State proof of driving experience is not required when obtaining a learner permit.

flagged.issue: The cited page does not state limited-term identity documents or SAVE verification.

flagged.suggested_fix: Limit the grouping to renewal timing on this page or also cite the replacement/address-change page.

flagged.issue: Page 31 states the Class D vision rule and screening but does not list the eleven MAB health groups.
flagged.suggested_fix: Class D requires 20/40 vision in one eye and at least 90° visual field with screening at the field office and at application if older than 65.

flagged.issue: Page 32 covers the review examination and hearing-officer decision but not the initial licence health questions and mailed FAE step.
flagged.suggested_fix: After a review examination a hearing officer reviews the FAE and decides on restrictions, with privileges withdrawn only if safe operation is impossible under any conditions.

flagged.issue: Lane changes and overall safe operation are not listed on page 33; they appear on page 34.
flagged.suggested_fix: Cite pages 33-34 for the full list including lane changes and overall safe operation, or omit those items when citing only page 33.

flagged.issue: The one-per-day, three-failure fee, and six-month completion rules do not appear on page 35.
flagged.suggested_fix: Change citation to pdf page 34 (printed page 24) where the practice, one-test-daily, three-attempt fee, and six-month rules appear.

flagged.issue: The page adds an exception when the last car is more than 500 feet away that the fact omits.
flagged.suggested_fix: Enter the shared center lane no more than 500 feet before the turn unless the last car is more than 500 feet from the intersection, after mirrors, signal and blind-spot check.

flagged.issue: The cited page states acceleration-lane and exit rules but the one-vehicle-per-green meter rule completes on the next page.
flagged.suggested_fix: Use acceleration lane to match speed; exit early and steady; metered ramp rule per page 41 allows one vehicle per green unless posted differently when meter-on sign is lit.

flagged.issue: The cited page supports slow/scan and left-right-left but stop-behind-line, no lane change, and merge-right rules are on the next page.
flagged.suggested_fix: Approach slow and scan and look left-right-left per page 41; stop-behind-line, no lane change in intersection, and merge-right steps are stated on page 42.

flagged.issue: The cited page covers continuous-flow turns but diverging-diamond and thru-U-turn descriptions are on the next page.
flagged.suggested_fix: Continuous-flow staged-signal procedure per page 42; diverging-diamond and thru-U-turn redirection details are stated on page 43.

flagged.issue: The cited page supports crosswalk and shared-lane limits but yellow/white lane-division meanings are on the prior page.
flagged.suggested_fix: Stop behind line and yield in crosswalk and limited shared-center entry per page 44; yellow versus white division meanings are stated on page 43.

flagged.issue: The cited page states the basic law and defaults but hazard-slowing list and impeding citation are on the next page.
flagged.suggested_fix: Basic reasonable-and-prudent law and area defaults per page 44; hazard slowing conditions and too-slow impeding citation are stated on page 45.

flagged.issue: The cited page supports railroad and regulatory signs but guide, warning-diamond, and work-zone fine/flagger details are on other pages.

flagged.issue: The cited page contains railroad, regulatory and route signs but no right-of-way priority rules.

flagged.issue: The statement is truncated to "Alcohol presec10-F03" and states no testable claim.

flagged.issue: Omits the 10-year prior-denial window and the or-until-age-21 whichever-is-longer qualifier.
flagged.suggested_fix: A second or subsequent offense within 10 years results in losing privileges for two years or until age 21, whichever is longer.

flagged.issue: Page 53 states no 0.05 BAC or 0.04 CDL threshold.
flagged.suggested_fix: Remove citation to this page; no BAC threshold is stated on this page.

flagged.issue: Omits the different under-21 revocation exception stated on the same page.

flagged.issue: The statement omits the additional prior-violation trigger for the higher penalty stated on the page.
flagged.suggested_fix: Texting is a Class C misdemeanor with maximum $100 fine, or Class B misdemeanor if bodily injury is inflicted or there is a previous violation.

flagged.issue: The cited page 69 does not discuss flooding water depths or turning around.
flagged.suggested_fix: Cite page 68 for flooding: six inches reaches bottom causing loss of control/stalling, two feet can carry away most vehicles, turn around if flooded.

flagged.issue: Page 70 supports dimming distances and lights but does not state longer following space or tinted-lens rule.
flagged.suggested_fix: On page 70, dim within 500 feet oncoming and 300 feet following and use lights when 1,000 feet not discernible; cite page 71 for following distance and lenses.

flagged.issue: The two-year / until-age-21 duration language does not appear on cited page 81.
flagged.suggested_fix: Move citation to pdf page 80, which states suspension may be for as long as two years or until 21st birthday.

flagged.issue: Cited page 82 states only the later revocation items; the earlier items like manslaughter and repeat intoxicated control are on page 81.
flagged.suggested_fix: Limit this fact to pdf page 82 items such as firearm discharge, explosive use, alcohol-restricted and interlock breaches, careless-driving revocation, handheld-device auto homicide, refusal, and two road-rage citations.

flagged.issue: The page addresses only motorcycle signals, not bicycle signals.
flagged.suggested_fix: Do not assume a motorcycle with a flashing turn signal will turn, as the signal may not have self-cancelled.

flagged.issue: The three-foot passing rule is not stated on the cited page; it appears on the next page.
flagged.suggested_fix: Cite pdf page 85, which states Utah requires a minimum of three feet from any bicyclist or vulnerable user passed.

flagged.issue: The summary omits the 80-inch width threshold, lamp counts and placement, and 500-foot night visibility.
flagged.suggested_fix: Buses, RVs and trailers 80 inches or more wide must have two amber front lights and side lights plus two red rear lights, visible from 500 feet at night.

flagged.issue: The summary omits the 350-foot high-beam and 100-foot low-beam distances and motorcycle exception.
flagged.suggested_fix: Except motorcycles, vehicles need at least two white headlights shining 350 feet on high beam and 100 feet on low beam.

flagged.issue: The summary omits the two-lamp requirement and the 500-foot in regular sunlight visibility standard.
flagged.suggested_fix: Vehicles must have two red tail/stop lights on the rear visible from 500 feet to the rear in regular sunlight.

flagged.issue: The summary omits lamp counts and 100-foot sunlight visibility and misstates front colors as pale.
flagged.suggested_fix: Turn signals need two red, yellow or amber rear lights and two white, yellow or amber front lights visible from 100 feet in normal sunlight.

flagged.issue: The page says the flag "should" be placed, not that it must be set.
flagged.suggested_fix: On a one-way street, the rear flag should be placed 200 feet to the rear.

flagged.issue: The page allows a red flag or other signal, not only a red flag.
flagged.suggested_fix: A chain, rope, or cable tow link must carry a red flag or other signal at least 12 inches square.

flagged.issue: The page also prohibits unreasonable swerving and covers any towed vehicle, not only a trailer.
flagged.suggested_fix: A driver must not operate a train of vehicles when any trailer or other towed vehicle whips or swerves dangerously or unreasonably from side to side.

flagged.issue: The statement omits the specific 80-inch width and 30-foot length thresholds.
flagged.suggested_fix: A disabled vehicle at least 80 inches wide or 30 feet long stopped over 10 minutes must display warning devices.
